itiśabdo lakṣaṇaprabhedānāṃ tadupayogyarthāntarāṇāṃ
ca praśnasya dyotanāya

tatra itiśabdapṛṣṭaṃ jñānabhūmikābodhopayuktamajñānabhūmikābhedaṃ
prathamaṃ vaktukāmo vasiṣṭho jñānājñānabhūmike vibhajya darśayati -
ajñāneti

etebhyo hetubhya ete bhūmike pratipadaṃ svasvaviṣaye baddhamūle satyau
svasvocitaṃ saṃsārasthitiduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ tanmuktinirtiśayānandāvāptilakṣaṇaṃ
ca phalaṃ saṃphalataḥ

yathā adhobhuvanabhuvaḥ saptapadā uttarottaraṃ
rajastamoduḥkhabahulā narakāntāḥ ūrdhvabhuvanabhuvastūttarottaraṃ
sattvasukhajñānabahulāḥ satyalokāntāḥ kramamuktiphalāśca
tadvadityarthādgamyate
tatra bhūmidvayasya pratyekaṃ phalataḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha - svarūpeti

padāntarāṇyasaṃkhyānīti yaduktaṃ tadupapādayati - punareva parasparaṃ
śliṣṭa iti
asya saptavidhasya mohasya pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇvityarthaḥ

cito
māyāśabalacaitanyātsakāśātsargādau jāgarādau vā prathamaṃ cetanaṃ
cidābhāsasaṃvalitarūpaṃ yatsyāttatprāṇadhāraṇādikriyopādhinā
bhaviṣyaccittajīvādināmaśabdānāṃ tadarthānāṃ ca bhājanaṃ
vakṣyamāṇajāgradbījabhūtaṃ sthitaṃ bījajāgraditi pareṇānvayaḥ

ayaṃ sthūladeho'haṃ idaṃ dehabhogyajātaṃ mama iti yaḥ
pratyayastajjāgradityarthaḥ
ayaṃ so'hamidaṃ tanme ityuktalakṣaṇasya jāgratpratyayasya janmānantaramuditaḥ

athavā sajātīyapūrvapūrvajnmasaṃskārodbodhena
dṛḍhataroditaḥ ata eva pīvaraḥ abhyāsādupacitaḥ

tathāhi
brāhmaṇādijanmasādhāraṇye'pi janmāntarābhyāsāt
keṣāṃcidbrāhmaṇocitakriyāsvabhiniveśaḥ pāṭavātiśayaśca dṛśyate na
sarveṣām

nidrānte nidrāmadhye nidrāvasāne vā
pratīyata iti pratyayaḥ
yaḥ pratyayo'nusaṃdhīyate sa svapnaḥ kathita ityarthaḥ

sa ca mahājāgratsthitermahājāgradantargatasthūlaśarīrasya hṛdi
kaṇṭhādi hṛdayāntanāḍīpradeśe bhavatītyarthaḥ

sa cāsya daivāddehanāśe'pi tathaivāgre'pyanuvartate iti sūcanāya kṣate dehe
ityuktam

suṣuptistu pūrvodbhūtakarmaṇāṃ bhogena
kṣaye uttareṣāmanudbhave'ntarāle chatrāpāyavatsarvasūkṣmasthūlaprapañcavilaye
tadbījājñānamātrapariśeṣāttadupahitātmamātrapariśeṣarūpetyāśayenāha -
jaḍā jīvasya yā sthitiriti

bodhayanti anubhāvayantīti
bhaviṣyadduḥkhabodhāni vāsanākarmāṇi tairāḍhyā saṃpannā suṣuptireva
sauṣuptī

suṣuptau kāraṇe vilīnasya jagataḥ saṃskārātmanā satvameva nāsatvaṃ
punarudbhavābhāvaprasaṅgādityāśayenāha - ete iti

dṛśaḥ sākṣiṇo
mahājāgraddaśāḥ santīti pṛthak padacchedo vā

iti uktavakṣyamāṇaprakārābhiścāruvicāraṇābhiḥ prabodhamale svayaṃ
pratyaṅmātraikarase ātmani dṛṣṭe sati asyāḥ avidyābhūmeḥ
sakāśātsamuttarasi nirgata evāsītyarthaḥ
